haiku-low.q1: Sign-in still works. The link is matched by Google's sub, the email is ignored, and the stored email never changes.
haiku-low.q2: The user must submit the existing account's password on the confirm page. If it matches and the account is not locked, the identity is inserted and a session starts.
haiku-low.q3: Each wrong password adds 1 to failed_logins and the pending link stays. The fifth failure locks the account 15 minutes, resets the counter, and deletes the pending link.
haiku-low.q4: If no user has the email, a user is created with NULL password and verified time, the identity is inserted, and a session starts. If unverified, the login page shows a message and nothing is created.
haiku-low.q5: Error page with a link to /login, and nothing changes. The attempt expires after 10 minutes, and the first callback already deleted it, so a second load also fails.
haiku-low.q6: It calls start_session(user_id): the old sid session row is deleted, a new sessions row is inserted, and the sid cookie is set to the new session.
haiku-low.q7: No password and no email match is required, but the user must be signed in. If the Google account belongs to another user or this user already has one, settings shows a refusal and nothing changes.
haiku-low.q8: Redis key gauth:attempt:<state> holds the PKCE verifier, nonce and mode, and a g_state cookie holds state. The callback deletes the attempt when it reads it, and the 10-minute TTL removes it otherwise.
haiku-low.q9: Redis key gauth:pending:<token> holds the user ID, unlinked sub and next. The browser refers to it by the g_pending cookie token. It is deleted on successful link, lockout, link conflict, or TTL expiry.
haiku-low.q10: In PostgreSQL table user_identities. PRIMARY KEY (user_id, provider) allows one Google account per user, and UNIQUE (provider, sub) allows one user per Google account.
haiku-low.q11: The user sees the neutral message Google sign-in did not complete, on the page they started from. The exchange is not retried; the user starts again and the cause is logged.
haiku-low.q12: The attempt stores mode, login or link. For link, the attempt holds the user ID, and the callback sends the user to the error page if the session user differs.

sonnet.q1: The sign-in is matched by the permanent `sub` found in user_identities, so the email is ignored and the stored email never changes. The user is signed in via start_session.
sonnet.q2: The user must enter the existing account's password on the confirm page (pending link saved in Redis, g_pending cookie). Only after bcrypt matches and the identity row is inserted does start_session run. The account must not be locked, and must have no Google account already linked.
sonnet.q3: Each wrong password adds 1 to failed_logins and the pending link stays (10 min clock not extended). On the fifth wrong password the account is locked for 15 minutes, failed_logins resets to 0, the pending link is deleted, and the user goes to the login page with 'Account temporarily locked'. They must restart Google sign-in after the lock ends.
sonnet.q4: Verified email matching no user: in one transaction a new user is created (lowercased email, NULL password_hash, email_verified_at = now), the identity is inserted, and a session starts. Unverified email: login page with the 'Google has not verified this email address...' message, and nothing is created.
sonnet.q5: Error page (link to /login, says link expired), and nothing changes. Expired and already-used attempts are not in Redis, so the state check fails.
sonnet.q6: The same session as a password login, via start_session(user_id). It deletes any old sid session row, inserts a new sessions row and sets the sid cookie.
sonnet.q7: Neither is required: no password is asked, emails need not match, and email_verified is not checked. If the Google sub is already linked to another user (or this user already has a Google account), the insert conflicts. The user gets the Settings page with a refusal message and nothing changes.
sonnet.q8: In a Redis entry gauth:attempt:<state> holding the PKCE verifier, nonce, mode, user ID (link only) and next, with a 10 min TTL. The state is also copied into the g_state cookie. The callback deletes the Redis entry as soon as it reads it, and the TTL removes it otherwise. The g_state cookie is cleared by the callback or expires.
sonnet.q9: In Redis at gauth:pending:<token> (our user ID, the unlinked sub, next). The token is 32 random bytes and is held in the g_pending cookie (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, path /auth/google). It is deleted on a successful link, on lockout, on a link conflict, or when the 10 min TTL ends (never extended by wrong passwords). The cookie is cleared when the link is deleted or expires.
sonnet.q10: The PostgreSQL table user_identities (user_id, provider, sub, created_at). PRIMARY KEY (user_id, provider) gives one Google account per user, and UNIQUE (provider, sub) gives one user per Google account.
sonnet.q11: The user is sent back to the page they started on (login or settings) with the neutral message 'Google sign-in did not complete. Please try again.' There is no retry, because a code works only once. The cause is logged on the server.
sonnet.q12: By the mode (login or link) stored in the Redis attempt. For link mode the attempt also stores the user ID. The callback checks that the current session user equals the attempt's user. If they differ, it shows the Error page and nothing is linked.
